svg.title: Control wiring for the smart traffic light parking assistant
svg.desc: TF-Luna lidar and a toggle switch wired to an Elegoo Uno R3, which drives a 4-channel relay module. TF-Luna pin 1 to 5V, pin 3 to D10, pin 4 to GND, pin 2 left unconnected. Switch between D12 and GND. Relay IN1 to D2, IN2 to D3, IN3 to D4, VCC to 5V, GND to GND.
svg.text: 4-channel relay module, active low — shown flipped so the header faces the Arduino
Lamp-side wiring continues in the next diagram
